description: Unique synthetic household identifier. Not a real household.
11-digit census tract GEOID (2020 vintage). Join key for tract geography.
5-digit Public Use Microdata Area code, a coarser geography than tract.
Household members aged 19 and over.
Household members aged 12-18. NOTE: includes 18-year-olds, unlike Census 'under 18'.
Household members aged 6-11.
Household members aged 4-5.
Household members aged 1-3.
Household members aged under 1.
Total household size, the sum of the six age-band counts.
Household size capped at 5 (5 means 5 or more). Drives the housing bedroom lookup.
ACS S1901 income band, 9 categories.
Annual household income in constant 2024 dollars (PUMS HINCP with ADJINC applied). Negative values floored to zero.
Food cost: USDA 2024 Low-cost plan per person by age band, times a household-size economies-of-scale factor.
Childcare cost: family child care home weekly rates times 4, for children under 12. Charged whenever children are present, regardless of adult labour force participation.
REQUIRED rent, not rent paid: HUD FY2024 Small Area FMR for the tract at the bedroom count implied by household size. Not tenure-adjusted; owners receive an imputed market rent.
Transportation cost: adults times the tract per-adult cost. Households with no adult aged 19+ therefore receive $0.
Lowest advertised broadband price in the tract. 141,050 households in 84 tracts receive a household-size-category mean fill.
Healthcare cost: employee share of age-banded premiums plus the amortised annual out-of-pocket maximum.
Other essentials, defined as 20% of food plus housing.
Annual Household Living Budget before tax: 12 times the sum of the seven monthly cost components.
Tax owed on the BUDGET income, from solving Y = C + T(Y) to convergence. Use for building the threshold ONLY. This is NOT this household's tax bill.
Total annual income required to afford the budget: hlb_no_tax_year + hlb_taxes_year.

Tax owed on this household's ACTUAL income. Use this for residual income, disposable income, effective tax rates and the Food Coverage Ratio. Can be negative where refundable credits exceed liability.
1 if hh_income < hlb_year. A like-for-like comparison: both sides are gross annual income in 2024 dollars.
